headline: Technical Writer
summary: Technical writer with five years documenting software and electronics products for manufacturers and SaaS companies in Clark. I write user guides, API references and release notes, keep documentation in Git alongside the code, and maintain the style guides that keep a team's writing consistent.
skills: Technical documentation: user guides, API references, release notes

experience.title: Technical Writer
bullets: Write and maintain the help centre and API reference for a logistics SaaS product used in 12 countries.
Moved all documentation into Git so docs are reviewed and released with each code change.
Created the team's style guide and templates, adopted by three product teams.
Rewrite engineers' feature notes into customer-facing release notes every two weeks.
Interview developers and support staff to find where users get stuck and fix those pages first.

experience.title: Documentation Specialist
bullets: Wrote work instructions and product manuals for electronic assemblies.
Controlled document revisions and approvals for the quality department.

education.school: Central Luzon College of Arts and Sciences
